about: Stages and settings for the quarter close playbook. scripts/handoff.py reads this file: the stages it tracks and the outcomes each stage can record. The other keys are read by the assistant following SKILL.md. Each key is explained under notes.

stages.name: measure
stages.do: Measure each live change the playbook runs made this quarter that no confirm stage has measured yet, one change at a time.

stages.name: review
stages.do: Build the QBR, with the work done and what each change earned taken from the runs and the measure stage.

stages.name: plan
stages.do: Plan next quarter's campaigns from the retail calendar, last year's evidence and current demand.

notes.min_days_live: A change must have been live at least this many days before the measure stage measures it. change-impact-tracker needs about 14 days of data after a change for a verdict other than too early to tell; younger changes are listed as too early, with the date to measure them.
notes.max_changes_to_measure: The most changes the measure stage measures in one session. Each change-impact-tracker run is a dozen or more calls; pick the ones with the most at stake and list the rest for later.
notes.plan_weeks: The window the plan stage gives campaign-planner: next quarter, from its first day.
notes.playbooks: Each playbook's title, product and stages in order. A stage names the skill that does it, whether that skill writes, what to do, the outcomes it can record, and product (campaign-planner needs Engagement: status suggests skipping the plan stage when the run has no project). The list of runs and changes (step 0) and the playbooks to run next (the output) aren't stages: no skill does them.
notes.playbook_for: Which playbook runs each kind of next-quarter play. These are skill names; the playbooks are separate skills, so when one isn't installed, name the skill the QBR play links instead.
